profileText: a Representative from Pennsylvania; born in San Diego, San Diego County, Calif., May 27, 1962; graduated from Northern High School, Dillsburg, Pa., 1980; B.S., Pennsylvania State University, University Park, Pa., 1991; Pennsylvania Army National Guard, 1980-2019; business owner; member of the Pennsylvania state house of representatives, 2007-2012; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Thirteenth and to the six succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2013-present).
